Question: My question is that my mother is a pious women who pray tahajjud and a very saintly type of women she wants to ask how much kuran should she recite in tahajjud 2.She also see dream in which she see a kid which is condired a shaitan by many scholar whenever she sees such thing some quarrel occur now she knows that this will occur when ever she sees a baby she pray namaz to avoid quarrel but then also it occur why? 3.Many people ask her to make dua for themselves and by allah's sake her dua gets kabool by allah subhanwataala can you say something regarding the dream which is a good book on interpretation of dream. Answer ID: 7453 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1854/1484=H/1429) (1) She can recite one para . (2) The Satan wants to engage her in pride and ego; she should keep on praying for protection from it. (3) There is nothing wrong, but ask her to treat those who request for dua better than herself. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
